senses.definition: ‖ אֶלְעָלֵה n.pr.loc. (God doth ascend?) of a village in the tribe of Reuben, near Heshbon, in ruins, el Âl (vid. RbBR ii, 278) Nu 32:3, 37 Is 15:4; 16:9 Je 48:34.
